fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-04-30, around 22:30, Deviga Murugan, aged 22, a college student, did not return after leaving for college; last known location was near Anbu Layout Bus Stand Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-04-30. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Jagan Velan (9000000339), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, photograph, CCTV, associate, night, bus stand
